description: Beat tracking: bpm, beats[] (seconds), downbeats[] (seconds), beats_per_bar, downbeat_offset, beat_map[{t, pos}], duration — the grid to place a part against a recording (beat n is at beats[n] seconds). Pass audio_key (an upload) or audio_url (a result URL from another job as returned, or any public https URL). Up to 10 minutes of audio is analyzed. Synchronous (~3–15 s). For key + sections + chords as well use doseedo_analyze_song. Cancel: not applicable — the result is returned in the submit response; the job is already finished.

audio_key.description: R2 ingest key of an uploaded audio file (from doseedo_get_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/ingest-url; starts with "ingest/"). Provide this or audio_url.

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio (a doseedo result URL as returned, or any public URL). Alternative to audio_key.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

name: doseedo_beat_grid
